.github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  macos:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [macos-15, macos-15-intel]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      CC: clang
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: 2
      RUST_TEST_THREADS: 2
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - name: OpenSSL 3
        run: |
          brew install openssl@3
          echo "FWP_OPENSSL_DIR=$(brew --prefix openssl@3)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Generated standard-library docs preflight
        run: |
          CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR="$PWD" rustc --test tests/stdlib_doc.rs -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/fwp-stdlib-doc-check"
          env -u FWP_BLESS "$RUNNER_TEMP/fwp-stdlib-doc-check" --exact stdlib_doc_is_current
      - name: Exact-head primitive contract inventory
        env:
          FWP_INVENTORY_EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/ownership-inventory"
          rustc --version > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ownership-inventory/rustc.txt"
          python3 scripts/check-primitive-inventory.py --baseline tests/fixtures/primitive-inventory-baseline.json --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ownership-inventory/candidate.json" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/ownership-inventory/audit.log"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: ownership-inventory-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ownership-inventory/
      - name: fmt
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
      - name: clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
      - name: test (GC stress golden suite runs in macos_gc)
        run: cargo test --all-targets --no-fail-fast -- --skip golden_programs_under_gc_stress
      - name: Preserve failed native golden binaries and C
        if: failure()
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/golden-failures"
          find "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'fwp-golden-*' -exec cp {} "$RUNNER_TEMP/golden-failures/" ";"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: golden-failures-${{ matrix.runner }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/golden-failures/

  # The stress golden suite took 57 minutes on Intel, leaving the serial
  # integration test binaries unable to finish within the 90-minute gate.
  # Both jobs are required per architecture; together they run the full suite.
  macos_gc:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [macos-15, macos-15-intel]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      CC: clang
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: 2
      RUST_TEST_THREADS: 2
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: OpenSSL 3
        run: |
          brew install openssl@3
          echo "FWP_OPENSSL_DIR=$(brew --prefix openssl@3)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Generated standard-library docs preflight
        run: |
          CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR="$PWD" rustc --test tests/stdlib_doc.rs -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/fwp-stdlib-doc-check"
          env -u FWP_BLESS "$RUNNER_TEMP/fwp-stdlib-doc-check" --exact stdlib_doc_is_current
      - name: Full GC stress and verification golden suite
        run: cargo test --test gc golden_programs_under_gc_stress -- --exact --nocapture
      - name: Preserve failed GC stress binaries, C and statuses
        if: failure()
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/gc-golden-failures"
          find "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'fwp-golden-gc-*' -exec cp {} "$RUNNER_TEMP/gc-golden-failures/" ";"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: gc-golden-failures-${{ matrix.runner }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/gc-golden-failures/

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
          # fwp itself as WebAssembly (tests/browser.rs, the playground)
          targets: wasm32-wasip1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: WebAssembly toolchain, OpenSSL headers (TLS)
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang lld wasi-libc libclang-rt-18-dev-wasm32 libssl-dev openssl
      - name: aarch64 cross compiler and qemu (tests/cross.rs)
        run: sudo apt-get install -y gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu libc6-dev-arm64-cross qemu-user musl-tools
      - name: binaryen's wasm-opt (`--wasm-async=asyncify`; tests skip without it)
        run: npm install -g binaryen
      - name: Generated standard-library docs preflight
        run: |
          CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR="$PWD" rustc --test tests/stdlib_doc.rs -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/fwp-stdlib-doc-check"
          env -u FWP_BLESS "$RUNNER_TEMP/fwp-stdlib-doc-check" --exact stdlib_doc_is_current
      - name: Exact-head primitive contract inventory
        env:
          FWP_INVENTORY_EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/ownership-inventory"
          rustc --version > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ownership-inventory/rustc.txt"
          python3 scripts/check-primitive-inventory.py --baseline tests/fixtures/primitive-inventory-baseline.json --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ownership-inventory/candidate.json" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/ownership-inventory/audit.log"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: ownership-inventory-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ownership-inventory/
      - name: fmt
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
      - name: clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
      - name: clippy (WebAssembly build)
        run: cargo clippy --target wasm32-wasip1 -- -D warnings
      - name: test
        env:
          FWP_REQUIRE_WASM_RESOURCE_COUNTS: "1"
        run: cargo test --all-targets --no-fail-fast
      - name: Preserve failed native golden binaries and C
        if: failure()
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/golden-failures"
          find "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'fwp-golden-*' -exec cp {} "$RUNNER_TEMP/golden-failures/" ";"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: golden-failures-linux
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/golden-failures/

  bench:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: OpenSSL headers (TLS)
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev
      - name: Generated standard-library docs preflight
        run: |
          CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR="$PWD" rustc --test tests/stdlib_doc.rs -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/fwp-stdlib-doc-check"
          env -u FWP_BLESS "$RUNNER_TEMP/fwp-stdlib-doc-check" --exact stdlib_doc_is_current
      - name: benchmarks against C and Rust (docs/benchmarks.md)
        run: cargo test --release --test bench -- --ignored --nocapture
.github/workflows/roadmap.yml:
name: Roadmap documentation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  roadmap_docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Retain review heads for preparation references
        run: git fetch origin "+refs/pull/*/head:refs/remotes/origin/review/*"
      - name: Documentation, immutable tags and commit messages
        run: python3 scripts/check-roadmap.py
      - name: Local guard sampling integration checks
        run: python3 scripts/test-local-guard.py
